content_sections.text: Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission has invited Online Recruitment Applications (ORA) from eligible candidates for recruitment to 04 posts of Deputy Director, Class-I (Gazetted), Group-A (Job Trainee) in the Department of Sainik Welfare, HP. content_sections.heading: HPPSC Deputy Director Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for HPPSC Deputy Director Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification, experience and other eligibility requirements mentioned in the official notification. Candidates should be a retired/released Ex-Indian Army Commissioned Officer of the rank of Colonel, Lt Colonel, Major, Captain or equivalent status of the Indian Navy/Air Force. Knowledge of customs, manners and dialects of Himachal Pradesh and suitability for appointment in the conditions prevailing in the state is desirable.

content_sections.heading: HPPSC Deputy Director Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age of candidates applying for HPPSC Deputy Director Recruitment 2026 should be below 57 years as on 01 January 2026.

content_sections.heading: HPPSC Deputy Director Salary Structure 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive fixed emoluments as per the Job Trainee scheme. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in HPPSC Deputy Director Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 04 vacancies available for the post of Deputy Director in the Sainik Welfare Department, Himachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for HPPSC Deputy Director Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 29 September 2026 up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for HPPSC Deputy Director Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should be retired/released Ex-Indian Army Commissioned Officers of the specified ranks or equivalent status in Indian Navy/Air Force.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of HPPSC Deputy Director Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selected Job Trainee candidates will receive Rs. 32,500 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for HPPSC Deputy Director Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Screening Test/Descriptive Subject Aptitude Test followed by Personality Test.
